sections.Profile:
"Torpedo!!" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in 1976. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, one pop bumper, two slingshots, two standup targets, a vari-target, a kick-out hole, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Boats, Single Player, Navy, War, Combat, Ocean, 1970s, Adventure
